title: TRUTH DECAY: Quantifying Multi-Turn Sycophancy in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on multiple-choice datasets (TruthfulQA, MMLU-Pro) across multi-turn dialogues where simulated users provide incorrect feedback, challenge the model's initial answers, cite external opinions, or state incorrect facts with confidence to measure the model's rate of switching answers and overall accuracy degradation.
